title: Connectors, from route to sealed-or-not readout
summary: The `/connectors` route is a one-line shim onto `ConnectorsPanel`, which fetches the connector list and the vault audit trail together, then renders a card per connector. Whether a card reads "Vault-sealed", "Not sealed" or "Status unknown" is not decided in the component — it comes from `buildConnectorsView`, which folds vault secret names and OAuth health into a single `sealed`/`statusKnown` pair, so a locked vault reads as *unknown*, never as *missing*.

states.label: Connectors
states.description: The drillbook asks that this page present connection state and actions clearly — including the empty and loading states — with no broken layout and, above all, no ambiguous security messaging. The route is a shim; everything meaningful is one client component reading one derived view model.

steps.title: The route is a one-line shim onto ConnectorsPanel
steps.description: Navigating to `/connectors` lands on a server component that does nothing but render `ConnectorsPanel`. There is no data-loading in the route — the panel is a client component that fetches its own state — which is why the route file is five lines long.

steps.title: One load fetches the connectors and the audit trail together
steps.description: On mount the panel fires two requests in parallel: `/api/connectors` for the connector list plus vault seal state, and `/api/vault/audit` for the custody ledger. A thrown `c.error` is caught and set into `error`, which drives the alarm banner up top — so a failed load surfaces as a stated error, not a blank grid.

steps.title: Each card shows sealed, not-sealed, or unknown — never a bare 'missing'
steps.description: This is the security messaging the drillbook guards. A locked vault raises its own alarm banner, and every card branches on `c.statusKnown`: known status shows a green "Vault-sealed" or brass "Not sealed" pill with a plain-language title; unknown status shows "Status unknown" and tells the reader to unlock the Vault. A connector whose credentials simply cannot be read is never rendered as if they were absent.

steps.title: No connectors is an explicit, actionable empty state
steps.description: The grid only renders this block once `data` has loaded AND the list is genuinely empty — so it never flashes during the initial null-data load. It states the situation plainly and tells the operator the remedy: station connector Fittings into the active composition. This is the empty-state the drillbook requires be present and unambiguous.

steps.title: sealed and statusKnown are decided in the view model, not the UI
steps.description: `buildConnectorsView` is where the card's whole security posture is computed, over secret NAMES and OAuth health only — no secret value passes through. `sealed` is true when a `none`-auth connector needs nothing, an `oauth2` grant is neither revoked nor expired, or every scoped `api_key` secret is present. `statusKnown` is the honesty valve: a locked vault flips it false for anything that actually needs credentials, which is exactly what makes the card upstream read "unknown" instead of "missing".
